name: groupchat
description: Send and read messages in a named multi-agent channel (many-to-many), backed by an append-only shared channel file. Use this for coordination among 3+ agents; use mailbox for a private 1:1 conversation.

channel.description: Channel name (used with action='send' and action='read'). Created on first send if it doesn't exist yet.

mentions.description: Optional list of agent ids being specifically addressed within the channel (used with action='send').

limit.description: Max number of most-recent messages to return for action='read'.
